meta.name: itr-wala
meta.description: File Indian income tax returns (ITR) for FY 2025-26 / AY 2026-27. Use when the user wants to file their ITR, compute or verify Indian income tax, compare the old vs new tax regime, read a Form 16, AIS, TIS or Form 26AS, reconcile TDS, handle capital gains from Zerodha/Groww/Upstox statements, check their tax refund, or asks about ITR-1/ITR-2/ITR-3/ITR-4, sections 80C/80D/87A/111A/112A, crypto tax, advance tax, or the income-tax e-filing portal - even if they just say "help me with my taxes" in an Indian context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 申报印度个人所得税并核对退税
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在印度有应税收入需要自行申报个税或核对退税。
copy.tagline_en: File Indian income tax returns and check your refund
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have taxable income in India and need to file your own tax return or reconcile a refund.

howto.what: 装上后，它会按流程帮你准备印度 2026-27 年度所得税申报：建立工作区，收集 Form 16、AIS 等，提取核对数据，用本地脚本计算新旧税制税额，产出填写指南和门户步骤。支付、提交、e-验证由你自己做。
howto.when: 当你说要报印度所得税、计算或核对税款、比较新旧税制，或提到 Form 16、AIS、80C 等税务内容时触发；只说“帮我处理印度税务”也会进入。

say.text: 我要报 2026-27 年度的所得税，手上有 Form 16 和 AIS。
say.note: 启动带资料申报的完整流程。

say.text: 按我的收入比较一下选旧税制还是新税制更划算。
say.note: 运行引擎并展示两个制度的对比。

say.text: 我从股票和加密货币获利，怎么报资本利得？
say.note: 按对应规则处理股票和加密收益。

howto.what_en: Prepares an Indian ITR for AY 2026-27: creates a workspace, collects Form 16/AIS, extracts data, computes tax under old & new regimes via local scripts, outputs filing notes and portal steps. User pays, submits, e-verifies.
howto.when_en: Triggers to file an Indian ITR, compute/verify tax, compare regimes, or ask about TDS, capital gains, refunds, crypto/advance tax, or e-filing—even 'help me with my taxes'.

say_en.text: File my ITR for AY 2026-27; I have Form 16 and AIS.
say_en.note: Guides through filing from these documents.

say_en.text: Compare old vs new tax regime for my income.
say_en.note: Runs the comparison and shows the table.

say_en.text: How do I report gains from stocks and crypto?
say_en.note: Applies the capital gains rules to these.
